name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

raster.snippet:
Show the details
Here they are.

use: One optional block the reader can reveal: details, advanced options, a long list.
defaultOpen when most readers want it open.
avoid: Content everyone needs; leave it in the flow.

a11y: A native <details> and <summary>; the platform exposes the expanded state and title is the name.
